inputs.description: Add a shelter reporting feature so users can report shelter status. (1) Create src/services/shelterReportsService.ts: store reports in localStorage (per-shelter, with timestamp), get reports for a shelter, aggregate recent reports (last 24h), (2) Create src/components/ShelterReport.tsx: a compact report form with quick-select options: Open/Locked/Crowded/Empty/Damaged/Key Required, (3) In ShelterPopup.tsx, add a "Report Status" button that opens the report form, (4) Show recent report badges on shelter popup and in the shelter list (e.g., "3 reports: Open" as a green badge), (5) In MapView, optionally color-code markers based on recent reports (green=open, red=locked, yellow=crowded, gray=no reports), (6) Reports are anonymous and local-only for now - community sync would need a backend. Add translations.
inputs.title: Add Community Shelter Reports
